title: Senior Buyer
description:
Senior Buyer (Indirect Procurement)


A global organization is hiring a Senior Buyer to join its Indirect Category team. This role supports a wide range of indirect spend categories (e.g., travel, corporate services, facilities, IT services, training, uniforms/workwear, and other business services), partnering closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver an efficient end-to-end purchasing experience. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented team player who will oversee the entire order process.



What you’ll do:

  • Manage day-to-day purchasing for assigned countries via a PO/requisition system, including processing requisitions in Workday.
  • Source suppliers, obtain quotes, negotiate, and ensure preferred suppliers are used.
  • Maintain supplier catalogs for repetitive purchases and manage open orders to ensure timely delivery/receiving in the system.
  • Build procurement reports/dashboards and partner with accounts payable to resolve invoice issues.
  • Lead local sourcing projects and negotiate contracts.
  • You will review proposals, negotiate prices, select the best suppliers, analyze trends, follow up with placed orders, verify delivery, approve payment, and maintain necessary records.
  • Perform commercial analysis on suppliers to develop more efficient processes and cost-effective solutions


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in purchasing, inventory, or supply chain management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • 5+ years in Procurement / Buying / Supply Chain;
  • Strong stakeholder management, ethics, and reporting skills
  • Advanced Excel/PowerPoint/Word.
  • Comfortable in a fast-changing environment; international travel may be required.
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory for this position.


Interested? Apply with your CV and a brief summary of your indirect procurement experience (categories, systems, especially Workday, and typical contract values).


Company details shared with shortlisted candidates only.

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto Java qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal terá uma sólida experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software, além de ser capaz de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico que abrange tanto projetos legados quanto modernos.


Responsabilidades:

- Atuar na arquitetura e design de soluções em Java, abrangendo versões que variam da 6 à 21, dependendo do projeto.

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em um ambiente de nuvem utilizando OpenShift da Red Hat.

- Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de UX/UI e front-end, especialmente em projetos modernos baseados em Spring Boot, enquanto lida com aplicações legadas que utilizam JSF.

- Projetar e implementar APIs, incluindo SOAP e REST, assegurando a observabilidade e a eficiência das soluções.

- Participar da atualização de versões do Java e no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, de acordo com as necessidades dos projetos.

- Aplicar princípios de System Design e Arquitetura de Software para criar soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.

- Ser receptivo a feedbacks construtivos e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa com diferentes equipes.


Requisitos:

- Sólidos conhecimentos em Java e Spring Boot (fundamental).

- Experiência em design de sistemas e arquitetura de software.

- Familiaridade com microsserviços e sua implementação.

- Capacidade de trabalhar com observabilidade e monitoramento de aplicações.

- Habilidades de comunicação e colaboração, com abertura para receber e implementar feedbacks.


Diferenciais:

- Conhecimento em front-end com React

- Familiaridade com Angular

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client

Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.

With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion.

You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.

Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption).

You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.

How You'll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.

Join Client!

Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity.

If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.


Nossos benefícios:


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Account Executive
description:
Company Description

Metrobi provides a fulfillment platform designed specifically for local businesses, empowering them to streamline delivery management and improve customer communication. The platform connects businesses with local contractor drivers and optimizes in-house delivery operation efficiency. Dedicated to supporting local food and beverage makers, Metrobi offers logistics tools to help expand their distribution networks. Metrobi makes delivery simpler, helping businesses grow with confidence and strengthen their local impact.


Account Executive


This is a remote, full-cycle Account Executive position focused on driving revenue by managing the entire sales process, from prospecting to closing, over the phone and via video conferences. You will manage a territory, conduct product demonstrations, and negotiate contracts to meet revenue targets. 


Responsibilities


  • Full-Cycle Sales: Own the entire sales process, from identifying prospects to closing deals.
  • Prospecting & Outreach: Execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns (phone, email) to generate your own pipeline.
  • Product Demos & Closing: Conduct high-impact virtual product demonstrations and presentations.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Negotiate contracts and finalize agreements to meet quarterly and annual sales quotas.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain an accurate CRM system (e.g., HubSpot) with detailed activity notes and forecasting. 


 Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive, Sales Representative, or relevant role (closing experience preferred).
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong experience with CRM software and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

title: Tech Lead de Dados
description:
O(a) Tech Lead de Dados é responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de dados, definir a arquitetura da plataforma de dados e garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e governança das soluções de dados e analytics da organização.


Esse profissional atua como referência técnica da área, combinando visão estratégica, liderança técnica e execução, assegurando que os dados estejam disponíveis, confiáveis e prontos para suportar decisões de negócio.

Liderança Técnica

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de dados e BI

  • Garantir qualidade, performance e segurança das soluções

  • Apoiar a resolução de incidentes críticos

Arquitetura de Dados

  • Implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e resilientes

Raw (Bronze)

Dados brutos ingeridos dos sistemas de origem

Silver

Dados tratados, padronizados e validados

Gold

Dados consolidados e prontos para análise e consumo

  • Garantir qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados
  • Definir estratégias de versionamento e lineage de dados


Cloud e Big Data (AWS)

Responsável por projetar e operar soluções de dados utilizando:

  • Glue

  • Integrar modelos de IA à plataforma de dados

title: Senior Buyer
description:
Senior Buyer (Indirect Procurement)


A global organization is hiring a Senior Buyer to join its Indirect Category team. This role supports a wide range of indirect spend categories (e.g., travel, corporate services, facilities, IT services, training, uniforms/workwear, and other business services), partnering closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver an efficient end-to-end purchasing experience. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented team player who will oversee the entire order process.



What you’ll do:

  • Manage day-to-day purchasing for assigned countries via a PO/requisition system, including processing requisitions in Workday.
  • Source suppliers, obtain quotes, negotiate, and ensure preferred suppliers are used.
  • Maintain supplier catalogs for repetitive purchases and manage open orders to ensure timely delivery/receiving in the system.
  • Build procurement reports/dashboards and partner with accounts payable to resolve invoice issues.
  • Lead local sourcing projects and negotiate contracts.
  • You will review proposals, negotiate prices, select the best suppliers, analyze trends, follow up with placed orders, verify delivery, approve payment, and maintain necessary records.
  • Perform commercial analysis on suppliers to develop more efficient processes and cost-effective solutions


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in purchasing, inventory, or supply chain management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • 5+ years in Procurement / Buying / Supply Chain;
  • Strong stakeholder management, ethics, and reporting skills
  • Advanced Excel/PowerPoint/Word.
  • Comfortable in a fast-changing environment; international travel may be required.
  • Proficiency in English is mandatory for this position.


Interested? Apply with your CV and a brief summary of your indirect procurement experience (categories, systems, especially Workday, and typical contract values).


Company details shared with shortlisted candidates only.

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: AI Creative Producer
description:
❗Please make sure to complete the form and apply for this position using the Easy Apply button on LinkedIn as well - otherwise, your application will not be considered.


❗Fluency in English and the ability to work within the European (CET) time zone are mandatory requirements for this position.


About Us

Prime Insights connects millions of users worldwide through our proprietary market research panel apps. Our technology powers a global community, delivering a world-class experience for members and actionable, data-driven insights for clients.

We’re building the next generation of our product ecosystem with AI at its core. Our mission is simple: use cutting-edge technology to create better user experiences and smarter business outcomes. We move fast, experiment often, and value people who build, test, and iterate.


Overview

We run a portfolio of rewarded apps used by millions of people, and we use AI to produce the creative that acquires them. We're looking for someone who sees AI tools the way a craftsperson sees their workshop — not as a shortcut, but as a way to make better things faster. You'll produce across formats: playable ads, UGC videos, animated gameplays, motion graphics, and statics. The through-line is taste. The output is yours.


What you'll produce

  • Playable ads - HTML5 interactive ads via our in-house AI generator
  • UGC video - AI-generated or AI-directed scripts, hooks, and edits
  • Animated gameplay - motion-based app demo ads and screen recordings
  • Statics & motion - banner ads, animated creatives, app store assets


What you'll own

  • Generating and art directing assets across formats using AI image, video, and motion tools
  • Running our playable ad generator - concepting mechanics, reviewing output, shipping network variants
  • Maintaining quality across a high volume of creative - knowing when something is ready and when it needs another pass
  • Staying sharp on what's working - feeding performance signals back into your creative decisions


You might be a fit if

  • You have a strong visual sensibility - you notice when something's slightly off and you fix it before anyone asks
  • You're fluent with AI creative tools - different LLM’s, Veo3, NanoBanana, Runway, Kling, Sora, or whatever's best for a specific task in hand
  • You've made things across multiple formats - not just one medium - and you can show us the decisions behind them
  • You're comfortable owning output end-to-end in a small, fast-moving team


Your Background

You come from a creative discipline - video editing, motion design, graphic design, art direction, or something adjacent. You know what good looks like because you've spent time making things, not just prompting things. AI tools are an extension of that craft, not a replacement for it.

  • Video editor — you understand pacing, hooks, and what makes a cut land
  • Motion designer or animator — you have a feel for timing, transitions, and visual rhythm
  • Graphic designer or art director — you compose, you direct, you know when to stop
  • Any combination of the above — the through-line is a trained eye


Nice to have

  • Background in mobile gaming, casual apps, or performance marketing creative
  • Familiarity with UA networks — AppLovin, Meta, TikTok, Google UAC
  • Some comfort reading or debugging HTML and JavaScript


Important Notice

❗We are not considering freelancers or consultants managing multiple projects . This is a full-time position .

❗Please do not contact team members directly regarding this vacancy. If you are interested, simply apply through the official job posting or contact the HR team directly .

title: Senior Application Development Consultant
description:
Job Title :: Senior Application Development Consultant

Location :: Brazil Remote

Job Type :: Contract

Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Application Development Consultant with extensive experience in application development, DevOps practices, and application architecture. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in utilizing the Agent Development Kit (ADK) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to deliver innovative solutions. • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 7-10 years of relevant experience in application development and consultancy.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


About Sisense

Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology.


With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.


The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance.


Why Join Our Customer Success Team

This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense’s growth in embedded AI analytics.


About You

  • You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused.
  • You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor.
  • You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs.
  • You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities.
  • You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred).
  • Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion.
  • Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships.
  • Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio.
  • Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI.
  • Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps.
  • Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus).
  • Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus.
  • Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities.
  • Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.


How You’ll Ramp

By Day 30

  • Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes).
  • Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value.

By Day 60

  • Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals).
  • Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work.
  • Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team.

By Day 90

  • Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion).
  • Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement.
  • Become a key contributor to the team’s revenue retention and growth goals.


What We Offer

  • Employment through a partner agency (B2B).
  • Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience).
  • Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus.
  • Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Salesforce - Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 57333


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Inglês avançado/fluente para atuação com time Global.
  • Experiência com Experience Cloud .
  • Ter experiência em desenvolvimento e customização na plataforma Salesforce (Salesforce CRM, Lightning, Apex, Visualforce, Aura e LWC), seguindo boas práticas de governança e arquitetura.
  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento (análise, implementação, testes, implantação, suporte e manutenção) da instância Salesforce.
  • Realizar codificação e integrações utilizando Apex, SOQL, SOSL e APIs REST, bem como ferramentas como Data Loader, Postman e recursos OOB (out of the box) do Salesforce.
  • Possuir conhecimento sólido em tecnologias web (JavaScript, HTML5 e CSS).
  • Utilizar controle de versionamento (Git/Bitbucket).
  • Colaborar com usuários-chave, arquitetos e consultores de negócio, realizando demonstrações e garantindo aderência aos requisitos funcionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, protótipos, fluxogramas, diagramas de sequência e planos de testes, assegurando qualidade e conformidade das entregas.
  • Realizar revisão de código e aplicar padrões consolidados de desenvolvimento (OOP, MVC/MVCS, Domain Layer Principle).


Diferenciais:


  • Espanhol avançado/fluente.
  • Ter experiência com Salesforce Commerce Cloud.
  • Possuir certificações Salesforce, como: Platform Developer I, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer II, Administrator, JavaScript Developer I, Data Architect, Sharing and Visibility Architect



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Physical Therapist
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Physical Therapist to join our team.

If you have a passion for improving lives through exercise, certifications in sports medicine or orthopedic expertise, we want to hear from you. Our ideal candidate has a minimum of 3 years of experience, along with additional certifications, and is proficient in advanced English.


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity for career advancement and professional growth.
  • Full-time position with the flexibility to work from a home office.
  • Engaging work environment with deep human interaction, focused on patient care.
  • Chance to make a significant impact on patients' health and well-being.


Salary:

  • After a paid initial 4 month intensive education and on-boarding process which is paid at 1st month 1st month: R$3,100, 2nd month: R$4,650, 3rd month: R$6,200, 4th month: R$7,750. After one year, there will be an opportunity to increase your income beyond R$7,750 with most team members eventually earning over R$9,300,  per month.

Join our team and be part of a dynamic environment where continuous training and deep human interaction are valued.

Full-time

title: Analista Pleno de Avaliação Econômica
description:
A Aldelia é uma multinacional franco-inglesa com foco em soluções de RH e terceirização de serviços. Atuante em diversos mercados, principalmente no setor de Óleo e Gás

Nosso cliente, uma grande servidora do segmento de produção e exploração de petróleo, está em busca de um(a) Analista Pleno de Avaliação Econômica para atuar na análise de viabilidade de projetos na indústria de Óleo & Gás. Este(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver modelos financeiros, interpretar resultados e apoiar decisões estratégicas relacionadas ao portfólio de investimentos da companhia .

Esta é uma posição CLT, terceirizada com a Aldelia, para um contrato de tempo indeterminado com nosso cliente. O escritório da empresa fica na Zona Sul do Rio de Janeiro e atuação será em modelo híbrido (3x2).


Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar e atualizar modelos econômico-financeiros para projetos de exploração, desenvolvimento, produção e descomissionamento.
  • Avaliar a viabilidade de investimentos utilizando indicadores como VPL, TIR, Payback e análises de sensibilidade.
  • Preparar análises e recomendações para comitês de investimento.
  • Consolidar premissas técnicas e econômicas em parceria com áreas como Reservatórios, Engenharia, Planejamento e Comercial.
  • Garantir aderência às regulamentações da ANP, regras fiscais e políticas internas de governança.
  • Apoiar melhorias contínuas nos modelos, bases de dados e processos de avaliação econômica.


Requisitos

  • Graduação obrigatória em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em modelagem financeira e avaliação de investimentos.
  • Domínio de Excel avançado (funções, estruturação de modelos e automações).
  • Conhecimento de metodologias como fluxo de caixa descontado, análise de sensibilidade e cenários.
  • Entendimento do mercado de Óleo & Gás, regimes fiscais e dinâmica de custos da indústria.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Economia, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Cursos complementares em modelagem financeira, avaliação de investimentos ou análises de risco.
  • Power BI e ferramentas de IA será um diferencial.
  • Espanhol intermediário será um diferencial.

title: Médico Endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Program Manager
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!




About the client

  • A global leader in weather data and forecasting, providing advanced analytics, AI-driven insights, and digital media solutions.
  • Offers high-volume weather data and tools that help individuals, businesses, and brands make informed decisions.
  • Operates large-scale digital platforms reaching hundreds of enterprise clients and millions of users worldwide.
  • Focuses on scalable, privacy-forward data solutions across web and mobile ecosystems.


About the role

This role involves leading consumer data initiatives, focusing on data collection, quality, and usability across digital platforms. You will bridge business analytics needs with technical data infrastructure, ensuring accurate and reliable data for reporting and machine learning.

The position requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and analytics. You will oversee data tracking systems, governance frameworks, and continuous improvements in data processes. The role also includes guiding teams and ensuring high standards in data integrity and accessibility.



Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (product, marketing, content managers) to translate business analytics requirements into technical specifications.
  • Work with enterprise data architects to define data plans, tracking requirements, and specifications for analytics.
  • Partner with front-end developers to implement event tracking systems.
  • Review and approve tracking implementations to ensure consistency and accuracy.
  • Guide data quality analysts to investigate and resolve data issues.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, BI engineers, and analytics teams to ensure data usability.
  • Establish and maintain data quality standards and governance frameworks.
  • Design and implement data validation processes for consumer behavioral data.
  • Develop automated data quality checks and alerting systems (e.g., dashboards).
  • Establish best practices for data instrumentation across web and mobile applications.
  • Lead the design and implementation of consumer data collection frameworks.
  • Drive continuous improvements in data infrastructure and processes.
  • Ensure data lineage documentation and metadata management.



Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, software engineering, or related roles.
  • 3+ years of experience managing consumer data from digital applications and websites.
  • 5+ years of Program Management experience
  • Strong proficiency in SQL.
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB).
  • Knowledge of customer data platforms (CDPs) and data collection methods (SDKs, cookies, pixels, APIs).
  • Experience with event tracking frameworks and multi-partner integrations.
  • Understanding of web and mobile analytics tools (Amplitude, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel).
  • Understanding of data privacy regulations.
  • Knowledge of A/B testing frameworks and experimentation platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data lake solutions (AWS S3, Glue, Athena, Azure Data Lake, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and cross-functional projects.
  • Strong communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Front-end experience in mobile and web development (2+ years).
  • Organized with excellent communication skills.
  • Willingness to complete a background check.



Conditions

  • 100% Remote role, primary timezone UTC-4, with at least 6 hours overlap required.
  • Contractor role, 3-month contract, renewable.
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • Device provided by the client (no BYOD required).

title: Business Analyst
description:
The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner on a daily basis, supporting the structuring, detailing, and communication of requirements and serving as an extension of the PO within the squad. This professional will help translate business needs into clear, actionable backlog items and ensure alignment between stakeholders and the delivery team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the right hand of the Product Owner, providing continuous support in backlog management and requirement definition.
  • Support the PO in the creation, refinement, and maintenance of Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria, ensuring clarity and business value.
  • Prepare and support backlog refinement sessions, ensuring stories are well‑defined, estimated, prioritized, and ready for development.
  • Serve as a key point of support for the squad to clarify requirements, scope, and dependencies on behalf of the PO.
  • Manage and maintain artifacts using JIRA (backlog, stories, tasks, progress tracking) and Confluence (documentation, specifications, and decisions).
  • Support Agile ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies when necessary, especially in the PO’s absence or when additional facilitation is required.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and the squad’s delivery capabilities.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst supporting Product Owners in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Strong expertise in writing and refining Epics, User Stories, Tasks, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Hands‑on experience with JIRA and Confluence.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong facilitation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to act autonomously as PO support while maintaining close alignment with the Product Owner.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and delivery‑focused mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Experience acting as a proxy or delegate for the Product Owner.
  • Experience supporting cross‑functional or distributed Agile teams.

title: Suporte Técnico de Inversor Fotovoltaico
description:
Descrição de Cargo:


Atendimento Técnico


1. Conhecimento dos inversores: É importante ter experiência com inversor, incluindo o entendimento de seus recursos, configurações, parâmetros e modos de operação.


2. Diagnóstico e solução de problemas: Ter habilidades em diagnóstico de falhas e solução de problemas é fundamental para o suporte técnico de inversores. Isso envolve a capacidade de identificar e solucionar problemas comuns, como falhas de comunicação, erros de configuração, sobrecargas, curtos-circuitos, entre outros.


3. Configuração: Em muitos casos, os inversores possuem interfaces de configuração, onde é necessário alterar parâmetros e ajustar as configurações de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes. Ter habilidades em configuração de inversores é valioso nesse contexto.


4. Habilidades de comunicação: Além do conhecimento técnico, é importante ter boas habilidades de comunicação para interagir com os clientes, entender suas necessidades, explicar soluções de problemas e fornecer suporte adequado. Isso inclui a capacidade de se comunicar claramente, ouvir atentamente e ser paciente.


Responsabilidades:


● Dar suporte técnico aos clientes à distância e de forma presencial (se necessário);

● Registrar os atendimentos diariamente;

● Preparar e aplicar treinamento;

● Participar de eventos e feiras do setor de energia atendendo ao público;


Requisitos:


● Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica

● Domínio no Pacote Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook;

● Disponibilidade para Viajar pelo Brasil;


Modalidade de trabalho:


● Home Office, de Segunda a Sexta-Feira das 09:00 ás 18:00h


Salário


De acordo com a experiência de trabalho com inversor fotovoltaico

description:
Senior Data Scientist


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: PJ


Buscamos por um(a) Senior Data Scientist para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em modelagem preditiva, inferência causal e geração de insights para tomada de decisão.

  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Produto, Marketing, Vendas e Customer Success.


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas e afins;
  • Experiência prévia em Revenue Operations, CS Ops, Sales Ops ou áreas correlatas;
  • Forte domínio de CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce ou similares);
  • Experiência com automação de processos (workflows, integrações);
  • Conhecimento sólido de métricas de receita (churn, NRR, LTV, CAC, conversão);

title: AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency
description:
AI Trainer - Advanced Japanese Fluency


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.


What you’ll bring

  • Advanced language skills and verifiable experience as being fluent in Japanese.
  • Fluency in English (B2+)
  • A willingness to take our skills verification test to assess your suitability for our Domain Expert participant pool
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to concentrate on complex tasks for up to one hour at a time
  • A reliable and fast internet connection and access to a computer
  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About Turnkey

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software.

The TurnKey team is growing fast and worldwide! We have employees located in Eastern European countries and Latin America (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Uruguay). We continue scaling remote software development teams for more than 30+ US-based enterprises and start-ups, including Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, Ironclad, BellXcel, etc. At TurnKey, we’re the ultimate matchmakers for US-based companies, creating remote dream teams.


Role Overview

We’re looking for a driven and detail-oriented Technical Recruiter to join our growing team. You will play a key role in sourcing and recruiting top tech and non-tech talent across Europe and Latin America , partnering closely with hiring managers and candidates to ensure an excellent recruitment experience from start to finish.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal teams and clients to understand hiring needs and role requirements
  • Source, screen, and engage candidates for a variety of technical and non-technical roles
  • Manage full-cycle recruitment: job posting, sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, collecting feedback, and offer negotiation
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for high-demand positions
  • Ensure a smooth and timely candidate experience, keeping stakeholders informed throughout the process
  • Collaborate with team members and hiring managers to continuously improve processes
  • Maintain accurate data in our applicant tracking systems and internal reports
  • Stay updated on regional hiring trends and market insights across Europe and LATAM


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles.
  • Strong knowledge of IT roles, technologies, and industry trends.
  • Familiarity with both technical and non-technical profiles
  • Solid sourcing skills and experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and other sourcing tools
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Experience hiring in Latin America
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, remote-first environment
  • Upper-Intermediate + level of English
  • Readiness to work in various time zones according to the candidates’ time zone


Why You Should Work at TurnKey:

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team.
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks);
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Free advanced English lessons with a budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work;
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes.
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together.
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise.

title: Product Owner Pleno (PO)
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um(a) Super Product Owner Pleno , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Produtos e que queria crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

Estratégia e visão de produto

  • Contribuir para a definição da visão do produto e alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Identificar problemas relevantes e oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados e feedback de usuários;
  • Priorizar iniciativas alinhadas aos OKRs trimestrais.


Discovery e validação de soluções

  • Conduzir discovery contínuo para entendimento profundo de problemas e necessidades;
  • Criar e validar hipóteses de solução antes da implementação em escala;
  • Construir ou apoiar a construção de MVPs rápidos utilizando ferramentas de IA, prototipação e low-code;
  • Testar soluções com usuários antes de direcionar o time de engenharia.


Gestão do produto e delivery

  • Criar épicos e histórias de usuário bem estruturadas, com critérios de aceite claros;
  • Gerir backlog upstream e downstream;
  • Priorizar e refinar demandas com o time de tecnologia;
  • Orientar o time sobre regras de negócio e objetivos das entregas;
  • Avaliar e aceitar entregas garantindo aderência aos critérios definidos.


Colaboração com o time

  • Trabalhar próximo aos times de UX, Engenharia e Dados;
  • Participar de rituais do time (dailys, refinamentos, planning e retrospectivas);
  • Garantir clareza de contexto e objetivos para o time multidisciplinar.


Gestão por dados

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Product Manager ou Product Owner;
  • Forte habilidade de priorização de backlog;
  • Experiência com Discovery e Delivery de produto;
  • Capacidade de estruturar histórias de usuário, critérios de aceite e cenários;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Miro ou similares);
  • Experiência com análise de dados de produto (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, HubSpot ou similares);
  • Experiência com testes e experimentação em produtos digitais;
  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em estatística ou ciência de dados;
  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.


O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade e abertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Project Manager (experience w/ EDI)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a Senior IT Project Manager with a minimum of 8 years of experience in managing complex IT projects.
  • Proven expertise in leading global E-Invoicing programs, EDI, or tax-driven IT solutions, ensuring legal compliance across multiple countries and SAP landscapes (S/4HANA and ECC).
  • Experience in driving global XSTORE upgrade projects (preferably V25), enabling standardized retail setups.
  • Strong knowledge of IT project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid), IT change and release management, and process management in regulated environments.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Jira/Confluence, MS PowerPoint, Teams, and preferably Clarity PPM.
  • Solid experience with SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC, particularly in billing and interface management.
  • Ability to translate legal and fiscal requirements into IT solutions.
  • Proven experience in coordinating external service providers and system integrators.

  • PMP or comparable project management certification is highly desirable.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Location: Portugal or abroad (Remote from Portugal or abroad options available).
  • Eligibility: Portuguese national, foreign national with existing permission, or foreign national in visa process.
