SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Analista de CRM Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)



Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso? Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Analista de CRM Sênior , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Revenue e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


Como Analista Sênior, você será a referência técnica e estratégica do time de CRM. Seu papel será construir e manter relacionamentos estratégicos e sustentáveis entre a SuperFrete e seus clientes. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar estratégias avançadas de personalização e comunicação, influenciando diretamente os resultados de conversão da empresa.



No dia a dia, você vai:


  • Estratégia e arquitetura de jornada: criar e implementar jornadas baseadas em dados unificados, mapeando processos de negócio para identificar gargalos e propor intervenções estratégicas que destravem valor.
  • Visão de dados: atuar na estratégia de unificação de dados dos clientes para garantir uma visão 360º, permitindo segmentações comportamentais avançadas e comunicações personalizadas.
  • Comunicação multicanal: idealizar campanhas que sejam relevantes para o momento do empreendedor, cuidando da narrativa e do impacto da mensagem em canais como WhatsApp, push, e-mail e SMS.
  • Uso estratégico do HubSpot: utilizar o potencial máximo das ferramentas de automação para viabilizar as estratégias de comunicação e otimizar as jornadas de relacionamento.
  • Experimentação e testes AB: liderar uma rotina de testes para descobrir constantemente novas alavancas de crescimento e conversão.
  • Análise e performance: monitorar KPIs de jornada e negócio através do HubSpot, Power BI e GA4, transformando dados em melhorias contínuas para a experiência do cliente.
  • Colaboração e mentoria: colaborar com as equipes de Marketing, Vendas, Produto e Atendimento para garantir a consistência dos processos; Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de CRM compartilhando boas práticas.
  • Inovação e melhoria de processos: acompanhar tendências de mercado, propondo novas soluções tecnológicas e abordagens para escalar a personalização e aprimorar a experiência do cliente através da automação de processos.


Requisitos



  • Experiência avançada em HubSpot, com foco em automação de marketing e análise de jornada para viabilizar projetos de comunicação;
  • Domínio de estratégias de comunicação multicanal, incluindo WhatsApp, push, SMS e e-mail marketing, entendendo as particularidades e boas práticas de cada canal;
  • Habilidade em copywriting e narrativa, com capacidade de criar textos que engajam o pequeno e médio empreendedor, utilizando gatilhos e tom de voz adequados para conversão, além de desenvolver campanhas segmentadas e personalizadas com base no comportamento dos clientes;
  • Forte capacidade de análise de jornada e dados, com experiência na definição e monitoramento de KPIs de conversão e interpretação de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Estratégia CDP & DMP: Compreensão de como a unificação de dados e a gestão de processos de negócio potencializam o CRM;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mensuração e analytics, como Appsflyer, Firebase e GA4;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos, com capacidade de estruturar e executar processos repetíveis, eficientes e escaláveis de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas.



Diferenciais


  • Experiência em startups e/ou empresas de tecnologia;


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist
description:
We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:


We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.


The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.


The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.


Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.


Responsibilities

  • Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
  • Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
  • Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
  • Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
  • Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
  • Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
  • Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
  • Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
  • Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
  • Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
  • Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
  • Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
  • You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
  • You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.


Compensation:

  • $2000 - $8000 USD per month


Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.

title: Cybersecurity Customer Success Manager - Brazil
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016 : Launched our first product.
  • 2018 : Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019 : Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020 : Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021 : Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition : Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025 : Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Role Overview:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Your mission->

I. Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

II. Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

III. Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

IV. Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

V. Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

VI. Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


What we're looking for:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.
  • Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!

  • Collaborate with business and application owners to resolve access risks

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a large-scale public sector S/4HANA transformation program for a metropolitan transit agency. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition.

The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.

The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.

The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.


Duties and Responsibilities:

The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.

  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).


Required Certifications:

  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.


Other:

  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou melhorias SAP.
  • Conhecimento de regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Certificação SAP FI (desejável).
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento em CO.
  • Diferencial: Inglês ou espanhol


Onde você irá trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido - Curitiba/PR.

title: SAP Tax Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented SAP Procure to Pay and Record to Report Tax Specialist to join our client's team in the technology sector. In this role, you will contribute to analyzing, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting SAP solutions, ensuring accurate localization for Brazilian and Mexican legal requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze, configure, test, deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico.
  • Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.
  • Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements.
  • Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions.
  • Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership.
  • Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes.
  • Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.
  • Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.
  • Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading tax localization and compliance solutions.

Requirements

  • Deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation, and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.
  • Experience with SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with various business stakeholders.
  • Ability to make decisions applicable to the level of influence in the organization.
  • Senior-level experience in a similar role.

Preferred Qualifications (if any)

  • Experience with tax calculation engines, e-invoicing, and withholding tax management.

title: Email Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is looking for a lifecycle marketing manager who can do more than manage a few email flows. We're building toward a leaner, AI-augmented marketing team, and this hire needs to be someone who can grow with that.

The role is broader than a typical lifecycle role. Think lifecycle strategy, campaign development, marketing ops, and audience intelligence — with AI as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • Design and run lifecycle programs across the full customer journey: onboarding, activation, retention, and winback
  • Own our HubSpot instance as it relates to marketing — workflows, segmentation, product data integration, and reporting
  • Use Clay to build and enrich audience segments for smarter targeting
  • Work closely with the rest of the marketing team on campaign development
  • Monitor and improve email deliverability on an ongoing basis
  • Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate, personalize at scale, and move faster
  • Report on what's working and what isn't — with actual numbers


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years in lifecycle, retention, or marketing ops at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep HubSpot expertise — you should be able to build complex workflows without a tutorial
  • Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation tooling
  • AI-native: you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically to how
  • Strong instincts on B2B customer journeys, PQLs, and usage-based growth models
  • You can write a decent email — you don't need to be a copywriter, but you shouldn't need one for every send
  • Comfortable owning work independently without a lot of hand-holding


NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience managing or scaling a lifecycle program from early-stage to mature
  • Familiarity with deliverability tools like MX Toolbox, Postmaster Tools, or similar


ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client makes it easier for creators to find the music they need. We license high-quality music and sound effects to filmmakers, agencies, and brands — and we're growing the team to match where we're headed.

They're remote, operationally lean, and genuinely open to how AI changes the way marketing works. If you want to build something real without a lot of bureaucracy, this is a good fit.

title: Consultor SAP FI – Suporte & Sustentação
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que buscamos?

O profissional atuará com foco principal em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade, aderência às regras locais (Brasil e LATAM) e alinhamento com diretrizes globais. Também participará de projetos, melhorias e iniciativas de evolução do sistema, conforme demanda do negócio.


  • Contrato: Vaga temporária - Duração de 1 mês, ideal para profissionais disponíveis imediatamente, atuando com SAP FI!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Atuar prioritariamente na sustentação e suporte do SAP FI, garantindo estabilidade do ambiente e atendimento às demandas do negócio.
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes e requisições relacionadas aos processos financeiros.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Finanças e Controladoria na correta utilização do sistema.
  • Garantir aderência às regras fiscais brasileiras e requisitos LATAM.
  • Realizar análises funcionais detalhadas e propor soluções alinhadas às melhores práticas.
  • Configurar, testar e validar soluções no SAP FI.
  • Apoiar processos como: Fechamento contábil mensal (Month-End Close); Integrações financeiras; Especificidades fiscais brasileiras; Integrações com outros módulos SAP.
  • Identificar melhorias contínuas em processos e parametrizações.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e evidências de testes.
  • Participar de projetos de implementação, rollouts, melhorias e upgrades SAP.
  • Conduzir workshops para levantamento de requisitos quando necessário.
  • Validar e testar especificidades Brasil e LATAM durante atualizações do sistema.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de CSV para garantir conformidade regulatória.
  • Assegurar qualidade e integridade dos dados financeiros no SAP.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente profissionais juniores, compartilhando conhecimento e boas práticas.
  • Atuar como interface entre Brasil/LATAM e Headquarter para temas relacionados a SAP FI.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia, Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em suporte e sustentação do módulo SAP FI.
  • Experiência em projetos de implementação ou melhorias SAP.

title: Cloudbees DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloudbees DevOps Engineer – Help Shape the Future of Continuous Delivery at a Global Financial Technology Leader!


Join a mission-critical engineering organisation at the heart of one of the world’s most influential financial messaging and payments platforms. Become part of a global DevOps Engineering Services team enabling modern software delivery, automation, and orchestration across a highly complex, secure, and fast-moving technology landscape. Supporting internal engineering teams across the enterprise, you’ll contribute to a mature and rapidly expanding initiative driving CI/CD/RO adoption - powering over 100+ applications and accelerating delivery excellence for teams primarily across the United States.


This is your opportunity to work inside a global organisation transforming the way software is built, released, and operated - while collaborating with senior engineers and DevOps experts across continents.


Your Role as a Cloudbees DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer within the DevOps Engineering Services team, you’ll help deliver internal tooling, automation, and release orchestration capabilities that empower hundreds of developers and application teams.

Working in a transversal function, you’ll support the rollout and optimisation of CloudBees Release Orchestration (RO) and CI/CD best practices, ensuring smooth adoption and consistent execution across the organisation. You'll contribute to a mature programme governed by senior engineers, with clear guidance, structured delivery, and high-impact outcomes across enterprise DevOps environments.


What You’ll Do

  • Support adoption of CI/CD and RO tooling across internal DevOps teams
  • Work closely with Senior Engineers to execute release orchestration onboarding tasks
  • Assist in scaling the enterprise adoption of CloudBees RO, Jenkins, CloudBees CI/CD
  • Enable best practices for Git workflows, artefact management (Nexus), and code quality (SonarQube)
  • Support SAST/DAST integration within secure delivery pipelines
  • Provide technical support to internal teams as they adopt enterprise DevOps tooling
  • Contribute to IaC and automation efforts using Python and Ansible Automation Platform
  • Support containerisation initiatives using Docker and OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Collaborate in an Agile, DevSecOps-driven environment to standardise delivery processes
  • Ensure accurate documentation, repeatable execution, and alignment to engineering guidelines


What You Bring

  • 4+ years of DevOps engineering experience
  • Hands-on expertise with CI/CD tooling, ideally CloudBees.
  • Hands on experience with Jenkins, Git, Nexus, SonarQube
  • Experience with SAST/DAST tools
  • Practical development experience in Java/Maven or C++
  • Exposure to infrastructure automation using Python and Ansible
  • Knowledge of containerisation: Docker, OpenShift/Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of Agile and DevSecOps principles
  • Excellent English communication skills (client teams are primarily US-based)
  • Ability to follow established engineering patterns and execute with precision

Why Join the Remobi Community

  • 100% remote B2B/freelance contracts
  • Access to a global network of top-tier engineering opportunities
  • Curated content, role alerts, and a supportive contractor community


Apply today: If you're ready to elevate software delivery excellence at scale and support a global CDRO transformation initiative - we want to hear from you!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Devops (foco em testes de Infraestrutura) para construir testes end-to-end abrangentes para nossa infraestrutura em AWS e fluxos de CI/CD. O foco do profissional para essa posição será dedicado ao desenho e implementação de automação de testes para a stack de infraestrutura, e não à gestão de sistemas em produção.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar testes end-to-end para fluxos de infraestrutura em múltiplas camadas (Terraform → Helm → CI/CD → Deploy de aplicações)
  • Construir automação de testes para pipelines de CI/CD no GitLab e para deploys de Helm Charts
  • Desenvolver infraestrutura de testes utilizando frameworks como Chainsaw para validação de Kubernetes/Helm
  • Criar frameworks de testes para prevenir infrastructure drift e identificar problemas de deploy antes que cheguem à produção
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time na definição de estratégias de teste para componentes complexos de infraestrutura


Experiências esperadas

  • Experiência em infraestrutura/DevOps, com forte foco em automação de testes
  • Experiência prática com frameworks de teste de infraestrutura (Chainsaw, Terratest, Kitchen-Terraform ou similares)
  • Capacidade de projetar estratégias de teste para sistemas complexos e multicamadas (não apenas testes unitários)
  • Experiência em testar os próprios pipelines de CI/CD (validando a lógica dos pipelines, e não apenas seu uso)
  • Experiência em produção com Kubernetes (preferencialmente AWS EKS) e entendimento de como testar configurações de cluster
  • Forte habilidade em programação voltada à automação de testes (Python, Node.js/TypeScript ou similares)
  • Experiência com Terraform e Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Experiência com AWS (EKS, RDS, S3 e serviços relacionados)


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com GitLab CI (ou ambientes de CI semelhantes)
  • Background em QA/Test Engineering aplicado à infraestrutura
  • Experiência com contract testing ou behavior-driven development (BDD) para infraestrutura


Ambiente Técnico

  • GitLab CI para deploys
  • Helm para configuração de Kubernetes

  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura Identity First

title: Motion Graphics Editor
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,100 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly creative Motion Graphics Editor/Designer to create standout performance content across a diverse portfolio of leading consumer brands.


This is a hands-on thinker/doer role for someone who can design, edit, and animate polished creative in a fast-moving environment. The right person is not just a strong editor, but someone with real motion design ability, strong visual instincts, and a sharp eye for layout, typography, pacing, and UI-driven storytelling. You should be comfortable creating elevated, design-forward work that feels intentional, modern, and performance-minded.


You will work closely with their internal teams and external stakeholders to develop digital and social creative across platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and more. The ideal candidate understands direct response marketing, knows how to balance speed with craft, and is eager to push creative quality while staying aligned to performance goals.


What You’ll Do:

  • Create high-quality motion graphics with a strong design sensibility, including typography, layout, compositing, transitions, and UI-based animation
  • Build polished ad creative that blends brand storytelling with direct response best practices
  • Review footage and produce edits with strong narrative structure, pacing, and shot selection
  • Quickly assemble edits, iterate on concepts, and implement feedback from clients and internal teams under tight deadlines
  • Design and animate visual systems, graphics, and screen/UI moments that make creative feel elevated and intentional
  • Manage media and organize assets across Google Drive, Slack, Notion, and Asana
  • Quality control exports to ensure all deliverables meet creative standards, technical specs, brand guidelines, and deadlines
  • Complete and transfer final deliverables to clients and stakeholders accurately and on time


What You’ll Need:

  • 2–5 years of experience in motion design, video editing, and digital creative, ideally within a DTC agency or other fast-paced performance marketing environment
  • Advanced motion graphics skills with a strong design eye — this role requires someone who can create polished, high-end work, not just basic animation
  • Strong visual taste and attention to detail across typography, layout, composition, pacing, and overall creative polish
  • Experience designing and animating UI-inspired or screen-based visuals is strongly preferred
  • High proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • Strong understanding of post-production workflows, visual storytelling, and how to make creative feel premium while still performance-oriented
  • Comfortable working from scripts, briefs, or loose direction while maintaining a high level of craft and creative consistency
  • Strong understanding of social platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and what makes content perform in each environment
  • A sharp sense of culture, trends, and creative strategy, with the ability to turn insights into engaging, high-performing work
  • Strong English communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a proactive, self-directed approach


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to create high-impact, performance-driven creative for leading consumer brands in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Engenheiro de IA – Especialista Full Stack em Agentes Inteligentes
description:
O que procuramos?

Engenheiro(a) de IA Especialista capaz de projetar e evoluir agentes inteligentes baseados em LLMs, dominando arquiteturas de orquestração com LangChain e LangGraph, construção de agentes multi-step e multi-agent, fluxos de memória, raciocínio e planejamento, além de integrações via APIs REST e desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis em microserviços. Profissional com sólido domínio de IA Generativa, RAG, Python, Node.js e React, capaz de criar sistemas robustos, observáveis e seguros, contribuindo ativamente para decisões estratégicas de arquitetura e inovação em IA.


Atribuições principais:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes inteligentes e autônomos baseados em LLMs, capazes de executar tarefas complexas de forma segura e escalável.
  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas avançadas de agent orchestration utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e plataforma de IA Generativa.
  • Desenhar e otimizar fluxos de decisão, memória, planejamento, raciocínio e execução em agentes de IA.
  • Integrar agentes a APIs REST de sistemas externos, com foco em Integrações de soluções corporativas.
  • Garantir observabilidade ponta a ponta, incluindo logging, tracing, métricas e controle de erros em sistemas baseados em agentes.

  • Contribuir ativamente para decisões estratégicas relacionadas a IA, arquitetura e inovação tecnológica.


Requisitos:

  • Background em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Forte expertise em IA Generativa e LLMs, incluindo design de soluções agentic;
  • Experiência prática e aprofundada com LangChain, LangGraph e construção de agentes multi-step e multi-agent;
  • Domínio de integrações via APIs REST;
  • Experiência robusta com microserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Proficiência em Python e conhecimento em Node.js e React;

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer

Na RapidPlay Games, nossos jogos não apenas funcionam — eles encantam. Cada spin, cada transição, cada efeito conta uma história. E quem dá vida a isso é a animação.

title: Backend Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong Backend Engineer who thrives in fast-moving environments and has a specialty in all things data. They are at an inflection point. Their product is live and working, customers are telling them what they need, and the engineering team is building rapidly.


You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running. This is not a data-first role that happens to touch the backend; it is a backend role where data mastery is your distinguishing edge.


What you'll do:

  • Design, build, optimize and maintain scalable features and systems across our Python/Django backend
  • Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform
  • Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale
  • Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently
  • Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development
  • Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows
  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems
  • Experience with the Django REST framework
  • Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code
  • Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)


We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.


Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.


In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.


As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Backend Data Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a strong Backend Engineer who thrives in fast-moving environments and has a specialty in all things data. They are at an inflection point. Their product is live and working, customers are telling them what they need, and the engineering team is building rapidly.


You will work deep in complex backend systems and will be their go-to person for everything data-related: ingestion, modeling, pipelines, and the infrastructure that keeps it all running. This is not a data-first role that happens to touch the backend; it is a backend role where data mastery is your distinguishing edge.


What you'll do:

  • Design, build, optimize and maintain scalable features and systems across our Python/Django backend
  • Design and build robust data ingestion pipelines to onboard, normalize, and continuously update third-party data sources that power our platform
  • Own data modeling and schema design across our platform, ensuring our data layer is structured for performance, flexibility, and long-term scale
  • Implement asynchronous and distributed processing to handle large-scale operations reliably and efficiently
  • Own data infrastructure tooling - including pipeline orchestration, storage, and warehousing - alongside application-layer development
  • Contribute to new product capabilities and integrations, working closely with other developers, AI engineers and data scientists
  • Collaborate directly with the CTO to define data strategy and technical architecture as the platform scales


What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex backend systems in production environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and Django (or a comparable framework)
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building data ingestion pipelines and ETL workflows
  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems
  • Experience with the Django REST framework
  • Understanding of Terraform or cloud infrastructure as code
  • Experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, or regulated data environments


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company at a pivotal stage, shaping scalable data-driven systems and architecture.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer


We are looking for a Senior Developer Data Engineer to build and operate scalable data pipelines and curated datasets that enable Digital and Customer Experience Applications across a global FMCG enterprise. You will work hands on with Python, PySpark, Databricks and SQL contribute to modern engineering practices using Gitbased workflows and CI/CD to support end to end delivery through Azure DevOps.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and optimize ETL ELT pipelines using Databricks, PySpark to ingest, transform and serve data for digital customer experience.
  • Build and maintain highquality performant SQL transformations and dimensional curated data layers for analytics and downstream consumption.
  • Implement best practices for Databricks engineering notebooks vs repos modular code cluster job configuration, performance tuning and cost awareness.
  • Use Python for data processing utilities validations orchestration helpers and reusable libraries.
  • Manage source control using Git with enterprise workflows across GitHub Bitbucket enforce PR reviews branching strategies and coding standards.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps automating testing packaging and deployment of data code artifacts across environments.
  • Ensure data quality and reliability through validations reconciliation, checks monitoring and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with product app teams analysts and platform teams to translate requirements into scalable data products aligned to customer experience journeys.
  • For Senior Developer lead module level design, mentor engineers drive standards for CI/CD and code quality and own delivery for critical pipelines.


Requirements

  • Strong handson experience with: Python, PySpark, Databricks, jobs workflows, clusters repos, SQL advanced querying optimization.
  • Strong experience with Git and repository platforms, GitHub and/or Bitbucket.
  • Hands on experience implementing CI/CD for data engineering workloads.
  • Strong working experience with Azure DevOps, Boards Repos Pipelines, build release workflows.
  • English for reading, writing and verbal communication directly with foreigners.


If this sounds like the next challenge for you, apply now with an updated resume in English and we'll take it from here :)

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação II
description:

Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades:


-Monitoramento e Resposta (SOC): Atuar como ponto focal em incidentes críticos, realizando análise forense inicial e contenção de ameaças;

- Engenharia de Detecção (SIEM): Criar, tunar e otimizar regras de correlação no SIEM para reduzir falsos positivos e aumentar a visibilidade sobre ataques modernos;

- Inteligência de Ameaças (Threat Intel): Coletar e analisar IOCs (Indicadores de Comprometimento) e TTPs (Táticas, Técnicas e Procedimentos), convertendo inteligência bruta em ações de defesa proativa;

- Gestão de Vulnerabilidades: Liderar o ciclo de vida de vulnerabilidades, desde a varredura e priorização (baseada em risco e exploitability) até o acompanhamento da remediação com os times de infraestrutura e dev;

- Hunting: Realizar buscas proativas por ameaças que possam ter passado despercebidas pelos controles automáticos.


Requisitos Técnicos:
